title: Syndicate Wars / Ghost in the shell inspired - DEV UPDATE #1 - Persuadertron online
author: KingQuiet880
selftext:
I made last video as just a mockup to see how much can be done with Codex/Meshy but since I got so many positive reactions I decided to go further and integrate some of the suggestions and what would be natural flow in-game:

1. Persuadertron mechanics (people with chips can be persuaded, speed and mechanics depend on the hacking skill of the player, NPC take weapons and shoot with you, act as body shield)
2. Gauss sniper rifle (have thermal vision, can kill inside vehicles)

Also improved HUD, a lot of other weapons, explosions, driving physics etc. (but I will save it for another video). I was even working on Metal Gear meets Crusader no remorse mechanics for indoors but I need to save something for another video.

Here is the link to the last one: [The Start](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1wxqhqw/comment/pf8i6t2/?screen_view_count=2)

comments.author: MotherPotential
comments.body: Awesome! Can't wait to see more!

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
How far away are you from having a demo of this you'd be satisfied having people test? 

I would legit love to give you feedback on this based on play. It looks like an amazing foundation for something special.

replies.author: gromul79
replies.body: What's your guess about sprites method?

replies.author: KingQuiet880
replies.body: Meshy for 3D generation, rigging and animations (although it has errors which needs manual adjustments), and then Codex for 8 + 8 directional conversion to 2D sprites with multiple animations.  As for player and combat NPCs - they are 3D with 2D imitations, due to fact they change multiple weapons and have numerous combat animations

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body: ...I wonder if my Daz3D models could provide a reasonable base for sprites. HM.

replies.author: KingQuiet880
replies.body: Does it has a working rigging system in place?

replies.author: AsparagusOk8818
replies.body: Yes; the whole advantage of Daz3D is that all of the models are incredibly easy to pose. So you could (fairly) easily put together not only a beginning and end frame, but also a few intermediate frames to help the model interpolate.

replies.author: KingQuiet880
replies.body: I could give it a try... Meshy is great for designing for 3D printing where structure, organization and rigging isn't  important but for game character designs... so-so. Does half way, other half you must do manually.

comments.author: Cr3L4real
comments.body: Today was the first time I heard of Syndicate Wars when my game was compared. This looks interesting and I would give it a try.

comments.author: IcieJuicy
comments.body: As a syndicate player, I saw persuadertron and was all in.
